claim_ceiling: Signed agent authorship of a producer lot declaration only; not legal producer authorization, physical origin verification, authenticity, receipt, freshness, food safety or allergen status.

cases.assert: producer_ref equals did_for_author(the exact Create action author), revision 1 has no predecessor
a DID for another AgentPubKey is rejected by integrity validation
producer_ref must equal canonical author DID
lot_ref must use mycelix:food-lot and a bounded canonical identifier
only FoodLotProvenanceV1 schema version 1 is accepted
producer lot quantity must be positive
unit and dimension are checked by the shared exact quantity kernel
evidence classes are an explicit allowlist
Measured requires calibration reference
IndependentlyAssayed and IndependentlyQualified require method reference
lot cannot claim food safety or product suitability
known date chronology must be coherent
every revision greater than one names a prior signed action
prior action author must match current signed author
revision chain cannot cross canonical lot or product identity
revision must equal prior revision plus one
producer lot record is create-only
producer lot record cannot be deleted
Listing and Order entries are not interchangeable with ProducerLotRecordV1
same supplier lot code from different signed authors remains distinct
